text: しおかぜに　ふかれ　ながら　のんびり　ポケモン　というのも　すてき　ですわね

structure.jp: しおかぜに　ふかれ　ながら
structure.en: while being blown on by the sea breeze

structure.jp: のんびり　ポケモン　というのも
structure.en: a leisurely bit of Pokémon, too

patterns.name: 〜ながら
patterns.explanation: ながら after a verb says two things happen at the same time. ふかれ　ながら = 'while being blown on'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: しおかぜに　ふかれ
patterns.explanation: ふく 'to blow' becomes ふかれる 'to be blown on', and に shows who does the blowing. しおかぜに　ふかれ = 'being blown on by the sea breeze'.

patterns.name: 〜という
patterns.span: ポケモン　というの
patterns.explanation: というの after a phrase wraps it up as 'the thing called...' so you can talk about it as an idea. のんびり　ポケモン　というの = 'this thing of doing Pokémon at a relaxed pace'.
